rationale.has_issues: Contributors need a place to question a decision that is not a second pull request in the same subnet — that trips the one-open-PR-per-subnet rule.
rationale.allow_merge_commit: false: one commit per promotion keeps the king's provenance a single sha.
rationale.allow_auto_merge: false: merging is the bot's decision, taken after a challenge, never GitHub's after a check.
rationale.lane_ids: ONE competition repository serves every subnet. Miners open PRs here and the lane is decided by which submissions/<subnet>/ tree the PR touches, so this repository needs every lane's membership label. One open PR per contributor PER LANE.
